chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz narrated from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Regarding the extra finger: if it is cut off, then one-third of the diyyah of a normal finger is due.

key_terms.ثُلُثُ دِيَةِ الصَّحِيحَةِ: one-third of the compensation of a normal healthy finger

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah for cutting off an extra finger in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning bodily injury compensation. It states that if a supernumerary finger is severed, the compensation is one-third of the diyyah assigned to a normal, sound finger.
